nodes.description: Hardcoded StakingContract instance stored at 0x8D8A...faAD, referenced by balanceOf for external deposit lookups.
External view function balanceOf(address owner) that returns the number of deposits held by owner according to the external staking contract.
Address parameter owner supplied by the caller and forwarded to the external call depositsOf.
Named return variable balance holding the length of the deposit array returned by the external call.
External call stakingContract.depositsOf(owner) executed against an external contract address, trusting its return data without validation.

edges.reason: Caller-supplied owner address is bound as the input of balanceOf.
The parameter owner is forwarded directly into the external depositsOf call.
balanceOf reads the stakingContract state variable to perform the external query.
State variable stakingContract determines the target of an external call, which is executed before state validation.
The array length returned by the external call is assigned to the balance local variable.
balanceOf returns the balance local variable as the function result.
The external depositsOf call can transfer control back into the contract before balanceOf completes, enabling reentrancy.

normalization_plan.reason: The owner parameter is a non-core data carrier whose only role is to be passed into the external depositsOf call, so it can be normalized into that unsafe operation.
The balance local variable exists only to hold the return value of balanceOf and can be normalized into the enclosing function.
